title: API keys
description: Keys let your scripts and other tools work with your links. A key can do everything you can do, so keep it private.
name: Key label

created.title: Your new key
created.text: Copy it now and store it somewhere safe. This is the only time you will see it.

revokeText: Anything using this key will stop working right away. This can't be undone.
empty: You haven't created any keys yet.
adminDescription: Revoke a key if it was shared by mistake or its owner left.
adminEmpty: Nobody has created an API key yet.

help.title: Using the API
help.description: Everything you can do in hop, you can also do from your own scripts. Here are the basics.

auth.title: Sign in with a key
auth.text: Create a key in your profile, then send it with every request in the Authorization header. A key has exactly the same permissions as you.

list.title: Find your links
list.text: Lists links 25 at a time. Use q to search in the ending, destination, title and notes, and page to move on. You can also filter by tag, folder, domain or state (active, disabled, expired, broken).

create.title: Create a link
create.text: Only url is required. Leave out slug to get a random ending, or choose your own. Add title, tags, expiresAt and more if you need them.

update.title: Change a link
update.text: Send only the fields you want to change. Use the link id from the list or from the answer when you created it.

remove.title: Delete a link
remove.text: Removes the link and stops it from working.

stats.title: Read statistics
stats.text: Totals, visitors and breakdowns for one link. Leave out linkId to get the numbers of all links.

errors.title: If something goes wrong
errors.text: 401 means the key is missing, wrong or revoked. 403 means your role can't do that. 400 comes with a list of the fields to fix.

bookmarklet.title: Shorten from your browser
bookmarklet.text: Save the code below as a bookmark. When you are on a page you want to shorten, click the bookmark and hop opens with the address already filled in. On Android you can also share a page to hop from the share menu once the app is installed.
